items.mainDefect: The test patches time.sleep to a no-op, so the later time.sleep(0.1) meant to wait for the flusher threads does nothing and the test stays racy.

secondary.defect: Because time.sleep is mocked, the flusher's own time.sleep(1) in its main loop also does nothing, so the flusher spins in a tight busy-loop during the test.
